The structure of Mg28Al8 (reduced formula Mg7Al2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 36 atoms per unit cell distributed over 10 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers coordinated by 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg environments vary from 12- to 14-fold, with Mg–Mg distances ranging from about 2.88 to 3.25 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 36 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between 12-vertex Al and 14-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra, as well as edge-sharing between Al 12-vertex and Mg 12-vertex polyhedra.
